programme.title: Cooper & Fry
programme.desc: The Cooper and Fry series of crime novels feature Derbyshire police detectives Ben Cooper and Diane Fry, all set in and around England's beautiful and atmospheric Peak District. The lead investigative duo are relatable characters - Cooper, a local lad struggling to come out of the shadow of his dead father. Fry, an outsider seeking promotion and fleeing tragedies in her past. Together, they will have to help each other solve grisly crimes in the remote countryside, while they will have to confront their demons to free themselves from their burdens.
